analysis.purpose: The first non-source-language extractor: ingests a classified Mule 3 or 4 project file — config XML, DataWeave, RAML, descriptors, properties — and emits the same graph vocabulary the language extractors emit.
responsibilities: Emit nodes and intra-file edges for flows, processors, routes and modules
Record cross-file names as references for the resolver to resolve later
Keep property VALUES out of the graph entirely

businessRules.rule: Only intra-file facts are produced; cross-file flow-refs, config-refs and includes are the resolver job.
businessRules.rationale: The extractor cannot see other files, so resolving here would mean guessing.

businessRules.rule: Cross-file names are kept as references on the enclosing node so the resolver can match them against real project files.
businessRules.rationale: Preserves the link without fabricating a path.

nodes.name: Mule extraction
nodes.summary: Graph vocabulary for Mule integration projects.
